description: Ramayana opened strongly at the box office, earning Rs 64.85 crore on its first day in India. The film experienced a slight decline on its second day, with Rs 48 crore net on Friday. Positive word of mouth is anticipated to boost the film's performance on Saturday and beyond. Early trends predict that the film could reach Rs 70 crore net by the end of Saturday.

title: INSIDE Shreya Ghoshal's Mumbai home: Cosy cream walls, rehearsal piano and balcony with city view
description: Singer Shreya Ghoshal invited director Farah Khan and her cook Dilip over for a cozy lunch at her stylish home. The open-plan living area afforded stunning city views, enhancing the intimate atmosphere. Shreya showcased her culinary flair with a delectable Bengali bhetki fish dish, complemented by Farah's mouth-watering roast chicken. The gathering wrapped up with a meaningful gift exchange, demonstrating the deep bond between the two talented women.

title: Diljit barred from performing 'Patiala Peg', '5 Tara Theke', 'Jeb Vicho Feem', 'Jatt Fire Karda' at Indore concert
description: In a move to ensure a safe atmosphere for young concertgoers, Diljit Dosanjh's forthcoming Indore performance will omit four songs associated with liquor and violence. Local authorities voiced concerns reflecting a historical court ruling that limits such music. Dr Punditrao Dharenavar has further urged for more restrictions concerning Dosanjh's show. The venue manager has been duly informed about these guidelines to protect the audience's well-being.

title: Farah Khan on life in showbiz: 'This industry makes you insecure, because...'
description: Farah Khan shares insights about her YouTube channel during a podcast with Neha Dhupia and Angad Bedi. She emphasizes the industry's pressures, which led her to create family-oriented content after taking a break from filmmaking. Farah discusses her experiences with insecurity and comparison within the film industry. Her channel has gained popularity with over 3 million followers, highlighting her collaboration with her cook Dilip.

title: Susmita Mukherjee says Ravana reflects our negative traits
description: Susmita Mukherjee, who plays the Dadi in Yami Gautam’s Nayyi Navelli, says Ravana is “only there as a mirror to show us evil,” representing negative qualities within us. Amid Ramayana’s Rs 200 crore worldwide run, she calls epics keepers of cultural wisdom.

title: Farah shares emotional tribute: Daughter recalls Zarine Khan’s light
description: On Zarine Khan’s first death anniversary, Farah Khan Ali shared handwritten letters from her mother, along with photos and videos. She wrote, “This is not a Diwali of celebration for me,” adding, “You loved life, Mom. And life loved you right back.” Zarine passed away in November 2025.

title: 'Kalki 2898 AD' team calls Kamal Haasan a 'supreme force of cinema'
description: Celebrating Kamal Haasan's birthday, the 'Kalki 2898 AD' team revealed a heartfelt behind-the-scenes image, highlighting his immense impact on cinema. They expressed their enthusiasm for his pivotal return in the sequel, especially after the film's recent triumph at the National Film Awards. Fans are now buzzing with anticipation for the next installment of this exciting saga.

title: In 2018, Denzel Washington helped raise $5 million to save August Wilson’s childhood home in Pittsburgh
description: The childhood home of playwright August Wilson in Pittsburgh has been transformed into August Wilson House. Denzel Washington helped raise $5 million to restore the property into a cultural center for the community. This building now offers studios, galleries, and spaces for educational activities for emerging artists. The restoration is a significant effort to preserve Pittsburgh's cultural history and encourage artistic expression.

title: In 2010, Kim Kardashian bought a Beverly Hills home where Kris Humphries proposed to her; the renovated mansion now lists for $8.5 million
description: A stunning Beverly Hills mansion, previously owned by Kim Kardashian from 2010 to 2013, is back on the market with an updated price of roughly $8.5 million. This five-bedroom luxury home showcases the lavish lifestyle of reality TV, highlighted by a memorable marriage proposal scene from Keeping Up With the Kardashians. Kim originally acquired this gem for $3.4 million and sold it in 2013 for about $3.

title: In 1985, Clive Davis moved into a Manhattan penthouse that has now hit the market for $11 million after his death
description: Clive Davis, the renowned music executive, has put his luxurious Manhattan penthouse on the market for $11 million. Having resided in this duplex for more than 40 years, Davis turned it into a vibrant venue for industry gatherings. The penthouse boasts stunning skyline vistas and two kitchens designed for entertaining. Nestled in the Ritz Tower, this historic abode mirrors Davis' illustrious musical journey, including multiple Grammy Awards.

title: In 1980, Stephen King bought a $135,000 Victorian mansion in Maine; today, it preserves his literary archives
description: Stephen and Tabitha King have breathed new life into their old Bangor family home by establishing a nonprofit literary preservation center. This inspiring venue features King's personal collection of manuscripts and photographs for public viewing by appointment. Furthermore, the neighboring Brown Mansion acts as a sanctuary for chosen writers, offering private accommodations and a $2,500 stipend to fuel their creative processes.

title: Ashok Selvan and Preity Mukhundhan's 'Anbil Avan' OTT release date confirmed
description: In 'Anbil Avan', Ashok Selvan and Preity Mukhundhan deliver a captivating performance that weaves together romance, family dynamics, and thrilling suspense. Premiering on SonyLIV on November 13 in five different languages, the film explores the unexpected hurdles a couple faces after relocating to their new residence, showcasing an exhilarating 70-foot jump by Selvan in a standout action scene, making it an engaging experience for online viewers.

title: Macklemore says 9 US venues turned him down for his ‘Free Palestine’ tour concerts

However, he revealed frustration as nine key US venues opted out of hosting his benefit performances for Palestine. Among the notable rejections is Madison Square Garden. As it stands, he has no upcoming concert dates planned for the United States.

title: Prerna Wanvari challenges 'first Indian Emmy presenter' Vijay Sethupathi

Actress Prerna Wanvari noted that Indian presenters have graced the ceremony since 2003, emphasizing the need to recognize the contributions of past Indian television figures. This year's event also features Indian content competing in two categories.

However, the Mumbai Cricket Association objected as the shoot interrupted scheduled inter-school cricket matches, sparking controversy. Frustrated by the challenges filmmakers face in Mumbai, Mehta called for more support from local authorities. 'Pralay' is a post-apocalyptic thriller starring Ranveer Singh, with a budget of Rs 300 crore.

With a greater production budget for Ramayana, enthusiasts are debating which film's success is more remarkable. Adipurush is celebrated as the highest-grossing opening non-sequel Bollywood film, highlighting the immense star power of Prabhas amidst stiff competition.
